definitions.gloss: mixed ground meat; ground meat blend of beef and pork
definitions.explanation: Ground meat that combines beef and pork, typically in roughly equal proportions. A staple in Japanese home cooking, used for hamburger steaks, meatballs, and other dishes.

examples.japanese: {合挽|あいび}き{肉|にく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦ハンバーグ→ハンバーグ：01785_hanbaagu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{合挽|あいび}き{肉|にく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧。
examples.english: Mixed ground meat works well for hamburger steaks.

examples.japanese: {合挽|あいび}き{肉|にく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧コショウ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}えて→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧こねる。
examples.english: Add salt, pepper, and egg to the mixed ground meat and knead well.

notes:
A compound of {合|あい} (combined/together) + {挽|び}き (ground/minced). Almost always used with ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧ as {合挽|あいび}き{肉|にく}. The standard ratio is roughly 50-50 or 60-40 beef to pork.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {合挽|あいび}き{肉|にく}: mixed ground meat
- {合挽|あいび}き⟦ミンチ→ミンチ：20032_minchi⟧: mixed minced meat
- {合挽|あいび}き{肉|にく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ハンバーグ→ハンバーグ：01785_hanbaagu⟧: hamburger steak made with mixed ground meat

USAGE:
In Japanese supermarkets, ground meat is typically sold as ⟦{牛|ぎゅう}ひき{肉|にく}→牛ひき肉：23362_gyuuhikiniku⟧ (beef), ⟦{豚|ぶた}ひき{肉|にく}→豚ひき肉：23445_butahikiniku⟧ (pork), ⟦{鶏|とり}ひき{肉|にく}→鶏ひき肉：23444_torihikiniku⟧ (chicken), or {合挽|あいび}き{肉|にく} (mixed beef and pork). The blend gives dishes more richness than either meat alone.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ひき{肉|にく}→ひき肉：17241_hikiniku⟧: ground meat — the general term for any ground/minced meat
- ⟦ミンチ→ミンチ：20032_minchi⟧: mince — loanword for ground meat, used interchangeably with ⟦ひき{肉|にく}→ひき肉：17241_hikiniku⟧
